summary: Verified end-to-end the new 'bukti bayar' (payment proof) feature on Pengajuan Keuangan. Backend pytest (test_iter152_fund_request_proof.py) covers full flow: sales creates expense pengajuan, finance approves, uploads proof file (owner_type=fund_request_payment), disburses with proof_ids (settled, payment_proofs stored with filename/content_type/size), appends another proof via /payment-proof, requester (sales) GET /{id} sees both proofs and downloads image via /files/{fid}?auth=<token>, sales POST /payment-proof returns 403, /payment-proof on not-yet-disbursed returns 400. Playwright UI covers: sales creates pengajuan; finance disburse dialog shows uploader fund-request-disburse-proof and disburse submit button is DISABLED until a proof is uploaded; after disburse row shows fund-request-proof-badge 'Lihat bukti bayar (1)'; finance detail sheet shows fund-request-proof-add-input + submit and adding a second proof increases badge to (2); sales list shows the badge, opens detail sheet rendering 2 fund-request-proof-item thumbnails and NO proof-add inputs. All test data (TEST_ prefix) and related journal_entries, cash_vouchers, events, activities, audit_logs, files cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: fund_requests._files uses 'original_filename' field which may be absent on legacy files; current _files() falls back to None but add_payment_proof requires filename be filled per spec — tests confirm image uploads via /files/upload set it correctly.
FundRequestProof pydantic uses min_length=1 so empty proof_ids POST returns 422 (acceptable).

Disburse dialog uploader is required at UI (submit disabled if !proofs.length) but backend disburse() does NOT enforce proof_ids presence — a direct API call with empty proof_ids will still disburse. Consider adding server-side guard to match UX contract.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_iter152 fund_requests created and cleaned up after each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment-proof feature on /fund-requests is working end-to-end. Only latent concern: backend disburse() does not require proof_ids on server side (UI enforces). Reusable regression file: backend/tests/test_iter152_fund_request_proof.py.
